items.title: 52031_Kenny Clarke oral history interview
items.q: When Cannonball came to New York... So they came there... Finally he comes up to me and touches me on the leg... he said, 'Hey, Kenny, may I blow one?'

ctx.x: So that's the way it was. When Cannonball came to New York, on vacation, because he was a schoolteacher in Florida, and he came to New York on his vacation, the month of August, with his brother. So they came to the Bohemia, which was a place where everything was really happening, you know, with Oscar and all, and Duke Jordan had just written, (Singing), all those things. Everything was happening. Everything, like innovation was just all over the place. So they came there, and Oscar had just written, "Bohemia…
